with_whisper.speaker: whisper
with_whisper.text: There. Lattice hardware, my line's band. The sender signs as Archivist Tal. My maker is a filing clerk. I do not know if that is better or worse.

choices.text: Trace it. We find Tal in person.
Answer it. Let them see you are not coming.

spoofed.speaker: whisper
spoofed.text: Dead. Officially. I have never felt lighter. Do not tell Kaj.

traced.speaker: whisper
traced.text: Tal. In an archive somewhere behind the Lattice enclave. When we go, I go in first.

answered.speaker: whisper
answered.text: They know my face now. Fine. Let them file it.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A Lattice beacon on an unused band, calling assets home by gene-line. Somebody built people to answer this.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: Whisper never had to hear this one answered. You cut the beacon for her.
